question: In 2023, Gulab Chand Kataria became the Governor of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulab Chand Kataria** was appointed as the Governor of Assam in 2023.
 
• He succeeded the previous governor, **Jagdish Mukhi**.
 
• Gulab Chand Kataria has a long-standing political career and has served in various capacities within the government of Rajasthan.
 
• His appointment as the Governor of Assam adds to his extensive experience in public service and governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The role of a Governor** in India is largely ceremonial, but they play a crucial part in the state's legislative process and in maintaining constitutional order.
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India and serves at the pleasure of the President.
 
• The Governor has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment or to suspend, remit, or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offense against any law relating to a matter to which the executive power of the state extends.
 
• The Governor is also responsible for appointing the Chief Minister and other ministers, and they play a key role during times of political instability in the state.
